hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [ -n "$f" ] && [ -f "$f" ]; then npx biome check --write --skip=correctness/noUnusedImports "$f"; fi

out=$(node scripts/check-design-tokens.mjs 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; echo '^ DESIGN-TOKEN VIOLATION (design.md is the authority): tokenize the value(s) above per design.md. No hardcoded colors, no text-[Npx]. Fix before continuing.' >&2; exit 2; }
